query:
UPDATE workouts
            SET end_time = datetime(COALESCE(last_activity_time, start_time), '+' || ? || ' minutes'),
                auto_closed_at = ?
            WHERE auto_closed_at IS NULL
              AND end_time <= start_time
              AND (julianday(?) - julianday(COALESCE(last_activity_time, start_time))) * 24 * 60 >= ?
